## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. 
> E.g., "I find it difficult to trace user actions because the logging library does not include transaction IDs..."

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Outline the API design, user interface flows, or config options if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
A list of alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered and why they were rejected.

## Acceptance Criteria
What must be true for this feature to be considered complete?
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
